_readme: Hand-written HSK levels for words the 2025 list leaves out (or levels you want to change). Keys starting with _ are ignored. The word must be in disorganized_hsk_vocab_with_radicals.json. load_hsk_lists.py prints every override it applies.

没.why: 没有 is HSK 1; 没 alone is missing from the 2025 list

天.why: 今天/明天/天气 are HSK 1; check the loader output -- remove if the 2025 list already has it

们.why: 我们/你们 are HSK 1; check the loader output -- remove if the 2025 list already has it
